text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My dear Trainer. With today being Valentine's Day, I've prepared a present for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'd like to give it to you now, so would you mind accompanying me somewhere?
choice_data_list: Where would you like to go?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The usual spots would be behind the school building or a local cafe to enjoy a chocolate parfait together…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's not far. By plane, it's about… seven hours or so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whooooosh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: There, have a look at this adorable cocoa tree.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I planted it just for you, Trainer. And now, this entire tree is yours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That means each and every cocoa bean it produces will belong to you as well, of course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's the Mejiro family for you. They operate on a different scale entirely… I never thought I'd be given my very own cocoa tree.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It'll be some time before it bears pods, so please wait a short while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let me see… Well, from what I've been told, around four years or thereabouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's going to take much, much longer than I thought before I get to savor any of this tree's produce…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm terribly sorry about that. But I do believe that the more patiently you wait, the more scrumptious the flavor will end up being.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Your own personal cocoa tree, Trainer, and the precious cocoa beans it will produce for you and you alone…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I wanted you to enjoy a flavor all your own. I expect it shall be one you'll never forget.
choice_data_list: You might just be right about that…
You might just be right about that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Delicious chocolate might be easy to find these days, but chocolate made from this particular cocoa tree…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It will have a flavor all its own. It looks like Mejiro Bright wants to gift me the experience of tasting it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I promise you, Trainer, that once this tree's cocoa pods are ripe, I shall use them to make chocolate for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'll grind them up, and griiind them up some more. ♪ Right up until they're a fine powder…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Then, after one more year…
choice_data_list: I'd rather you picked up the pace at that point…
I'd rather you picked up the pace at that point…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At this rate, every step of the process is going to take a full year. I feel my mouth twitch into a wry smile as the two of us enjoy the scenery of the cocoa fields.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Bear in mind that the first year the tree's ready to be harvested won't be the only year I make chocolate. Cocoa trees really are something, you know…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I hear that they produce beans for fifty whole years.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That's right, and I wish to make chocolates for every single one of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I imagine the taste will vary from year to year, what with the weather and temperature changes. But then…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We'll also change as the years pass. And we'll make more and more memories as we do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A lot can change over the course of fifty years. It's possible that nothing we have now will stay the same.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Change can be a little frightening, but it can be a source of excitement, too. Changes are just one more thing for us to treasure. Oh, and…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I do believe some things will stay the same. Specifically…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro family… and the bond you and I share.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I think it'll last forever, you know. Our bond.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fifty years from now… this tree will have grown huge. And we'll still be here together, talking beside it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's just a wee tree at the moment. But in time…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With good stewardship, this tree will grow to be as everlasting as the Mejiro family itself.
